nom: Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water All-in-1 Cleanser & Makeup Remover

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily skin reports the product leaves the T-zone prone to breakout unless followed by another cleanser.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and non-drying, preferring the liquid form over balms or wipes, though one notes it dries out the skin around the nose.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin (oily T-zone) found it worked well without worsening her dry patches, while another says it is not ideal for combination skin without a follow-up cleanser.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no irritation, no burning in the eyes, and gentle cleansing, while a few describe stinging eyes, increased irritation, or skin texture changes.
segments.mature: No mature-skin-specific reports are present in these reviews.

concerns.aging: No reviewers describe anti-aging effects or complaints in this set.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it hydrates or does not strip the skin, feeling soft, smooth and fresh after use; one reviewer with dry/eczema-prone skin found it hydrating and non-irritating, though one other says it made her skin feel dry due to sensitivity and one notes localized dryness around the nose.
concerns.redness: No explicit redness complaints or relief are reported.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with eczema-prone skin reports no irritation and a hydrating effect, suggesting compatibility with a compromised barrier; another sensitive-skin reviewer reports stinging and worsened irritation.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe an extreme case of severe, painful cystic acne and permanent scarring attributed to the product, alongside multiple acne-prone reviewers reporting no breakouts and even perceived improvement in acne when paired with a face wash.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers report no new blemishes and cite it as part of a routine that keeps skin clear, but one reviewer reports a severe cystic breakout covering her whole face upon use and repeat use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers note it removes excess oil without leaving skin greasy or sticky, while one reviewer with oily/combination skin reports it can trigger T-zone breakouts if not followed by another cleanser.

Leaves skin feeling soft and fresh

extraits.texte: Ruined my skin and life. Please read if you want to avoid the worst breakout of your entire life. Before using this product, I had beautiful, clear skin, almost perfect! with maybe 2 pimples around my cycle which would go away on their own. This broke out EVERY. SINGLE. INCH. of my face. My skin erupted with blackheads, whiteheads, HUGE cysts that were so painful that It was excruciating to wash my face. I went to dermatologists and for months i was put on antibiotics, steroid creams, EVERYTHING. NOTHING worked. It was an emotional rollercoaster that left me with permanent purple acne scars all over my face. It was so bad that people asked me if it's contagious. I couldn't figure out what was wrong I never would have thought a micellar water would cause this. I ran out of it and never bought it again and my skin cleared within 2 weeks. I then used it once again, just to track where the breakouts were coming from, and boom, Instant painful cysts in 2 days. Please guys. Stay far away from this !!!!! So many reviews said the SAME thing what are they putting in this?!

extraits.titre: This product's okay but not for me
extraits.texte: I'm a teen and I have sensitive skin I've tried to use this a couple times thinking it would work but it did not it had always made my skin very irritated and burn when I touched it and it didn't remove all my makeup. it makes my skin feel smooth but that comes from dryness although this product has never broken me out it makes my skin even more sensitive I've seen this product work on other people but not me.

extraits.titre: This product is not for combination or oily skin
extraits.texte: This micellar water removes most makeup well but I need to follow up with another cleanser or I will have breakout on my T-Zone. This product would work best for normal to dry skin.
I have acne-prone skin and always notice a tingly sensation after use and dont exactly feel clean. Micellar water is great for double cleansing, I just dont prefer using it when I don't have to.

I have sensitive skin (combo on T-zone) and this cleansing water worked great for clearing up my face and not exacerbating my dry skin issues. It's been hard finding products that work with my skin type.
Removes makeup well, doesn't break you out, and I'm very acne-prone. Another plus is that it's safe to use with lash extensions because it doesn't contain oil.
I have very dry and eczema prone skin so I tend to stick to specific miceller water removers. This one was hydrating and did not irritate my skin
